title: SEC Reporting Requirements
learning_objectives: Identify major SEC forms and filing requirements
Distinguish between periodic and current reports

sec_overview.mission: Protect investors, maintain fair/orderly/efficient markets, facilitate capital formation
sec_overview.authority: Enforce federal securities laws, regulate securities industry
who_must_file: Companies with ≥$10M assets and ≥500 shareholders (or ≥2,000 total shareholders)

registration_statements.when: Initial public offering or major offering
registration_statements.content: Detailed company info, business, financials, risk factors

registration_statements.purpose: Short form for established issuers (shelf registration)
registration_statements.when: Company meets eligibility (well-known issuer, reporting for 12+ months)

periodic_reports.due: 60-90 days after fiscal year end (based on filer size)
periodic_reports.content: Audited financial statements, MD&A, risk factors, governance, exhibits
Material events: earnings, M&A, officer changes, bankruptcy, etc.
periodic_reports.items: Specific triggering events listed in form instructions

proxy_statements.content: Proposals, director elections, executive compensation, auditor ratification

beneficial_ownership.when: Acquirer obtains >5% with intent to influence control

beneficial_ownership.due: 45 days after year end (or 10 days if mid-year for certain filers)

regulation_s_x.purpose: Form and content of financial statements filed with SEC
regulation_s_x.scope: Specifies accounting standards to follow, presentation, footnotes required

regulation_s_k.scope: MD&A, business description, risk factors, executive compensation, governance

regulation_s_b.note: Integrated into Reg S-K; formerly separate small business provisions

regulation_fd.purpose: Fair disclosure - prohibit selective disclosure of material nonpublic information
regulation_fd.requirement: If material info disclosed to analysts/investors, must simultaneously (intentional) or promptly (unintentional) disclose publicly

edgar_system.name: Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis, and Retrieval
edgar_system.purpose: Electronic filing system for SEC documents
edgar_system.requirement: Virtually all SEC filings must be filed electronically through EDGAR

sarbanes_oxley_key_provisions.section_302: CEO/CFO certify accuracy of financial statements and effectiveness of disclosure controls
sarbanes_oxley_key_provisions.section_404: Management assess internal control over financial reporting. Auditor attest (for large accelerated filers).
sarbanes_oxley_key_provisions.section_906: CEO/CFO criminal penalties for false certifications
sarbanes_oxley_key_provisions.pcaob: Created Public Company Accounting Oversight Board to oversee auditors of public companies

examples: Results of operations and financial condition (earnings release)
Creation of direct financial obligation or obligation under off-balance-sheet arrangement
Costs associated with exit or disposal activities
Changes in accountants or disagreements on accounting

md_a.title: Management's Discussion and Analysis
md_a.perspective: Management's view of financial condition and results

cpa_exam_strategies.forms: 10-K (annual, audited), 10-Q (quarterly, unaudited), 8-K (current events). Form S-1 (IPO registration).
cpa_exam_strategies.deadlines: 8-K: 4 days. 10-Q/10-K: Varies by filer size (60-90 days for 10-K, 40-45 for 10-Q).
cpa_exam_strategies.regulations: S-X (financial statements), S-K (non-financial disclosures), FD (fair disclosure).
cpa_exam_strategies.rarely_tested: SEC topics are low weight. Focus on basic forms and filing requirements.
cpa_exam_strategies.if_tested: Usually conceptual (what form is used for X?) not detailed application.

key_points: SEC regulates public company reporting under securities laws
10-K: Annual report (audited financials). 10-Q: Quarterly (unaudited). 8-K: Current material events.
Form S-1: Register securities for IPO. Form DEF 14A: Proxy statement.
Regulation S-X: Financial statement requirements. Regulation S-K: Non-financial disclosures.
EDGAR: Electronic filing system, public access to filings
Filing deadlines vary by accelerated filer status (based on public float)
SOX 302: CEO/CFO certify accuracy. SOX 404: Internal control assessment.
